subject: SummitBridge SIG — telemetry evidence, encrypted logs & delivery timetable
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@summitbridge.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG telemetry ask — encrypted logs and sample delivery

Karthik,

Thanks again for the SIG questionnaire submission. A few follow-ups from our security team after reviewing your control mappings:

- We need an example bundle showing how telemetry is collected, redacted, and stored (file-level sample is fine) — preferably encrypted at rest; an explanation of key management is required.
- Can you confirm retention windows for telemetry logs and any automatic purge processes?
- Our legal team also wants a timetable for delivery of artifacts (control mapping spreadsheet, sanitized telemetry sample, and signed attestations).

Can you share a proposed delivery schedule this week? If certain artifacts need an NDA or secure transfer method, please flag that.

Regards,
Elena Morales
Senior Security Manager
SummitBridge Capital

--
Attachment: SIG-ask-summary.pdf (stub)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@summitbridge.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG telemetry ask — encrypted logs and sample delivery

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below; Jasmine (security) and Grace (Customer Success) are on the thread to execute artifact packaging and delivery.

- Telemetry bundle: we can produce a sanitized sample tarball that demonstrates collection, redaction, and encryption at rest. We will NOT include live PII or customer-identifiable data. The sample will be encrypted using customer KMS-managed keys (AWS KMS by default) — documentation of the envelope encryption will be included.
- Retention: default telemetry retention is 90 days for detailed traces, 365 days for aggregated metrics; we can configure shorter retention for enterprise agreements and will document the purge workflow and retention policies.
- Delivery timetable proposal:
  * Nov 23 — control mapping (spreadsheet) and retention workflow doc
  * Nov 23 — sanitized telemetry sample (encrypted tar.gz) delivered via secure transfer (ShareFile/SFTP)
  * Nov 24 — signed attestation PDF (if legal requires DocuSign, we can route)

If that works, Jasmine — can you prepare the sanitized sample + notes on redaction and KMS flow? Grace — I'll coordinate the secure transfer details and HubSpot update to mark artifact delivery.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: SIG telemetry ask — encrypted logs and sample delivery

Karthik / Grace — quick internal notes before we hand off to Elena:

- Sanitization checklist: strip IPs, remove user IDs, replace any model prompts with placeholders, and truncate full-text interactions. We'll include a README that lists every field removed or transformed.
- Encryption and key management: we will provide the envelope encryption description (AES-256-GCM for data keys, data keys wrapped by AWS KMS customer-managed CMK). For SummitBridge we can accommodate either a Redwood-managed CMK or provide instructions to use their own KMS key for wrapping — note this affects who has decryption capability for the sample.
- Retention proof: attach log-rotation cron snippet and S3 lifecycle policy excerpt; note that the telemetry pipeline applies automatic purge jobs with job IDs and timestamps stored for audit.

I'll build the sanitized bundle and the small technical appendix this weekend and upload to the secure folder. ETA remains Nov 23 for the files.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com

Elena / SummitBridge team — delivering the artifacts as promised. See links and attachments below. If you'd prefer a direct SFTP push instead of Drive share, let us know and Grace will coordinate.

Delivered artifacts (attached / shared):
- SIG-Control-Mapping-v2.xlsx (attachment) — updated mapping with control IDs and owner notes
- telemetry-sample-encrypted.tar.gz (attachment) — sanitized telemetry bundle encrypted with AES envelope keys; README included inside archive explaining redaction and fields removed
- summitbridge-qa-responses.pdf (attachment) — concise answers to your three follow-ups and retention citation examples

Delivery notes and access:
- Encryption: sample encrypted with a data key wrapped by AWS KMS (CMK alias: alias/redwood-sig-demo). If SummitBridge requires key-wrapping with your CMK, we can rewrap the data key and send via secure channel; that will require your KMS ARN and a short coordination window.
- Retention: as Jasmine noted, default retention is 90/365; we've included an S3 lifecycle snippet and the audit purge job log (redacted).
- Transfer channel: files also uploaded to secure Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLinkForEvidence (access granted to elena.morales@summitbridge.com). We can move to ShareFile or SFTP if preferred.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm receipt and that the level of redaction meets your policy.
2) If legal needs a signed attestation, I'll route a DocuSign today — provide the signing contact and we will prepare the one-page attestation.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on your side.

Karthik Iyer
